head_start: Give your coding agent a head start in Blender
intro: Use Foundry’s wizards yourself or work alongside a coding agent. Foundry can generate starting assets on your PC, saving your agent time and tokens on Blender tasks.
skill_intro: Foundry’s companion skill teaches your agent how to use the workflows and grows alongside the app.
how_to: Choose any Blender skill repositories you want, then copy the setup prompt and paste it into your agent’s chat.
recommended: Blender skills I use and recommend
thanks: These are the skills I use in my own Blender projects. Thanks to EL4CTEO and 1Pio for sharing their work.
blender_skills: A remarkably complete set of 28 skills, from modeling and UVs through materials, rigging, quality checks, and export.
workbench: An excellent hands-on companion for working in Blender. It helps your agent compare references, inspect geometry, and review the result as it goes.
blender_needed: Install Blender to use these skills. EL4CTEO’s set is built for Blender 5.2 and later.
copied: Setup prompt copied. Paste it into your agent’s chat.
copy_manually: The prompt is selected. Press Ctrl+C or use Copy to copy it.
unavailable: Could not read this installation. Open Foundry on this computer and try again.
prompt_intro: Set up my local Mumblebox 3D Asset Foundry in this coding agent so I can say “Use Foundry” in a future session.
prompt_skill: Bundled Mumblebox Assets skill entry point — {path}
prompt_environment: Prepare the dedicated MCP Python environment at {folder} using {python} and its venv module. Use the new environment’s Python to install the pinned dependencies from {file}. Reuse that environment if it is already set up.
prompt_register: Register this stdio server in the current client’s persistent MCP configuration. Use its supported configuration format and keep the command and each argument as separate values.
prompt_verify: Install the entire bundled Mumblebox Assets skill folder in this client’s supported skills directory, including its compatibility record. Connect to the MCP, call foundry_workflows to verify that it can list workflows, and tell me if this client needs to reload before using them.
prompt_repos: Install all skills from each selected repository in this client’s supported skills location. Confirm what this client can load.
blender_skills_install: Use the repository’s documented installer for this platform and client to install the full Blender skill set.
workbench_install: Install the complete repository as the blender-workbench skill, including its references and scripts.
prompt_blender: Check whether Blender is installed and reuse a suitable existing installation. If Blender is missing or needs a newer version for a selected skill set, explain what is needed and give me the official download page at {url}. Continue setting up Foundry.
prompt_use: When we work on 3D assets, use Foundry to generate a starting asset locally when it fits the task. Use Blender and the installed Blender skills to inspect, refine, assemble, or export the result.
